source: make a kawaii skincare morning routine were you have a kawaii anime character and you wake her up in her kawaii cozy pink bed and do her skincare and make her Breakfast

answers.ask: Is this one bedroom, or a whole little apartment with a separate kitchen?
answers.answer: Use one cozy pink bedroom with a small breakfast nook in the same room, keeping the map compact and focused on the morning routine.

answers.ask: Does the routine have a scored or timed completion, or is it free play?
answers.answer: Make it free play with no score or timer, so players can enjoy the kawaii routine at their own pace.

scene_prompt: Create a compact kawaii morning-routine room: one cozy pink bedroom with an anime-inspired character’s pink bed as the central focal point, and a small breakfast nook in the same room. Arrange a skincare area near the bed with a vanity or counter for skincare items, while the breakfast nook sits to one side with space for preparing and serving breakfast.

## Genre

The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim: the free-play morning routine is open-ended character care rather than a timed task simulation. No secondary genre is needed.

## Shape and preset

Use `interior-single`, one compact room that is the entire map with no outside transition. The preset is none because no Roleplay & Avatar Sim preset represents a focused single-room morning routine without adding a town, social hub, pet loop, or runway.

## Config requirements

Draw one cozy pink bedroom centered on an anime-inspired character’s pink bed. Use `npc-population` for exactly one kawaii anime-inspired character occupying the room. Add a nearby skincare vanity or counter visibly stocked with skincare items and a small breakfast nook to one side with preparation and serving surfaces. Keep all furnishings cohesive, soft, cute, and compact.

## Layout requirements

Place the single `npc-population` character at the bed, positioned to support the wake-up scene. Add two uncatalogued interaction placements: one aligned to the usable side of the skincare vanity and one within reach of the breakfast preparation surface, while keeping both clear of circulation. No score, timer, checkpoint, or competitive volume is needed.

## Layout components

The build is one enclosed room with three activity areas: the central bed zone, the nearby skincare vanity, and the side breakfast nook. Short open floor connections link all three without corridors. Include one pink bed, one vanity or counter with skincare props, and one compact preparation-and-serving nook. Bedroom walls form the boundary. Frame the bed as the focal point while keeping both side stations visible and accessible.

## Render order

Use `isometric`: render the kawaii room dressing and focal composition first, then derive the simple top-down arrangement.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost

Scale is small, driven by one compact room and three closely linked activity areas. The theme is cozy pink kawaii anime morning routine. Use `P0`; the entire map is one interior on a single surface with no outside transition, overhang, or structure-critical topology.
